newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines Dec load factor slips.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines Dec load factor slips.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc said late Thursday that its systemwide load factor in December 1996 was 73.6 percent, a decrease from 74.0 percent in December 1995.

Revenue passenger miles in December 1996 increased to 337.6 million, an increase of 4.4 percent from the year ago period, while available seat miles increased 4.9 percent to 458.4 million, Hawaiian Airlines said.
December's cargo ton miles surged 18.3 percent to 5,086,000, the carrier said.
